lead: Hazari Prasad Dwivedi was an Indian writer, born on 19 August 1907 in Ballia district.
He died on 19 May 1979 in Delhi at the age of 71.
He is associated with work such as Alok Parva and has been recognised with Sahitya Akademi Award and Padma Bhushan.
